author: dan131riley
body:
#### PR description:

#46951, which was supposed to remove `-Ofast` from compilation of one file, has an embarrassing typo (found by @mmasciov/Claude) that removes the flag from all of MkFitCore.  This PR fixes the case of the flag.

#### PR validation:

Technical fix.  Compiles without warning, verified with `scram b -n` that `-Ofast` is removed only from the one file IterationConfig.cc.
title: Fix removal of Ofast from just IterationConfig.cc
